course_description:
Theory of general linear model-topics include: least squares, generalised method of moments and maximum likelihood estimators under iid, autocorrelated and heteroskedastic error specifications.

The purpose of this course is to provide the theoretical background to many econometric techniques covered in ECON2300.ﾠIt deals with the theory behind the techniques rather than the implementation of the techniques.ﾠIt also covers material on testing, generalised method of moments, and maximum likelihood estimation not encountered in ECON2300.ﾠMatrix algebra is an important mathematical tool that is used throughout this course.ﾠThe course has been structured so that you can learn the necessary matrix algebra as an integral part of the material. Lectures will present theoretical concepts in detail.

learning_outcomes.description: Apply matrix algebra proficiently to derive properties of (and compute) various econometric estimators.
Explain the theory behind the General Linear Regression Model.
Derive and explain the numerical and statistical properties of the OLS, GLS and IV estimators.
Understand the finite sample and asymptotic properties of the OLS, GLS and IV estimators.
Use statistical packages such as R-Studio to compute the various estimators on real world datasets.
Apply the learned theory and methods to the real world.

learning_activities.topic: Linear Algebra and Regression Review of statistical concepts and matrix algebra. Learning outcomes: L01

Linear Algebra and Regression Review of statistical concepts and matrix algebra. We begin to present the regression model using vectors and matrices. This set us up for both moment estimation and least squares estimation. Learning outcomes: L01
PUBLIC HOLIDAY - Royal QLD Show As Wednesday is a public holiday in Brisbane, there will be no lecture this week. NOTE: Tutorials will still run as normal this week.
Geometry of Linear Regression 1 Geometry of vector spaces; geometry of OLS Learning outcomes: L01, L02
Statistical properties of OLS 1 Statistical Properties of OLS Learning outcomes: L02, L03
Statistical Properties of OLS 2 More on the statistical properties of OLS. Learning outcomes: L04
Hypothesis Testing and Confidence Intervals 1 Some common distribution. Exact and large sample tests. Learning outcomes: L04
Hypothesis Testing and Confidence Intervals 2 More on hypothesis testing and confidence intervals. Learning outcomes: L04, L05
Generalized Least Squares (GLS) GLS estimator; FGLS; Panel Data Learning outcomes: L03, L04
Mid-Semester Break No lectures or tutorials during the break.

Moment Estimators: Instrumental Variables and GMM IV Estimation: In this lecture we show how the OLS estimator can be presented as a moment estimator. We then consider different moment conditions that lead to the IV estimator. Learning outcomes: L03, L04
GLS; FGLS; Panel Data GLS; FGLS; Panel Data
Maximum Likelihood Estimator The underlying theory of the Maximum Likelihood Estimator (MLE), including properties and simple examples. Links to OLS and GLS.
